wf.title: High-Resolution Print Banner Design
wf.brief: Need a high res banner for large format printing based on the attached design. Final must be 72" x 39" Final in vector or high res (150dpi min) for printing Match the attached design. Background image of lanterns does not need to be exact, can use stock photos or AI, but needs to be very similar to the example and high res. Text should match. Font and colors should match as closely as possible.
wf.summary: Client wants a 72x39 inch print banner matching their reference design, with lantern background, same text, fonts and colors.
wf.skill: Matching a client's reference design exactly
wf.pitch: I can build your 72x39 inch banner to match your reference, with the same text, fonts and colors and a similar lantern background. I'll deliver a print-ready file at 150dpi or in vector format. Would you like me to send a quick layout preview before final export?

practice.q: Which part of the brief is the client most likely to check first when they receive the banner?
options: That the text, fonts and colors match the reference
That the lantern background is an exact copy
That the file is saved as a small web image
practice.why: Clients judge a match by whether the text, fonts and colors look like their reference. The background only needs to be similar in style, so spend your effort on the layout and typography.
practice.need: I'll match your text, fonts and colors exactly, and deliver a 72x39 print-ready file at 150dpi or vector.

wf.title: Promotional Social Media Post Graphics
wf.brief: I need a creative designer to craft eye-catching post graphics for my feed that focus on promoting my products and services. The visuals must feel cohesive across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn while still respecting the nuances of each platform. Expect to work with existing brand colours, fonts, and a style guide I will share, then translate that into scroll-stopping imagery paired with concise, high-impact copy placeholders. Deliverables: • At least six static feed posts, supplied in native design files (PSD or AI) plus ready-to-upload PNG/JPEG exports in platform-specific sizes. • Editable text layers so I can update offers and captions. • A quick usage note showing layout grids, font
wf.summary: Client wants six cohesive social post graphics (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn) using their brand style guide, with editable text layers.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need beyond just pretty posts?
options: Six random eye-catching designs in any style
Consistent branded visuals that promote offers across platforms
A full social media strategy and posting calendar
practice.why: Cohesion and brand consistency matter more than novelty here. Read the style guide closely, then adapt each post to each platform's sizes and feel, with editable text so offers can change easily.
practice.need: I'll deliver six platform-sized, on-brand post graphics with editable text layers for your offers.

wf.skill: Turning a client's brand brief into consistent visuals
wf.pitch: Hi, I can create six on-brand post graphics for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn using your colours and fonts, with editable text layers so you can update offers easily. I'll send native PSD or AI files plus ready-to-upload exports and a short layout guide.

wf.title: Modern Company Brochure Design
wf.brief: I'm looking for a modern and professional brochure to introduce my company and its services. The brochure will be shared with potential clients at meetings or events. The brochure should include: - Company story - Past jobs - Services - Contact details Ideal skills and experience: - Strong graphic design skills - Experience with brochure layouts - Ability to convey information clearly and attractively - Portfolio showcasing modern and professional designs Please provide samples of similar work.
wf.summary: Client wants a modern, professional company brochure with company story, past jobs, services and contact details, shared at meetings and events.

practice.q: What does the client really need the brochure to do once it's in a prospect's hands?
options: Look pretty on a shelf
Win trust and start conversations
Show every past project in detail
practice.why: Good call. A brochure handed out at meetings has one job: make a stranger trust you enough to call. Lead with clarity and credibility, not decoration. Keep text short and scannable.
practice.need: I'll design a clean, modern brochure that tells your company story and services clearly, ready for print.

wf.skill: Briefing the client: finding the real goal behind the request
wf.pitch: Hi, I read your brief for a modern company brochure. I'll design a clean, professional layout covering your story, past jobs, services and contact details, with print-ready files. Would you like to see a sample layout first?

wf.title: Event Graphics Design Specialist
wf.brief: I am looking for a graphic designer to design a poster for an upcoming performance. Our director did a mockup using ChatGPT, but I would like to hire a human to make the artwork. Must NOT use AI to generate your design. Looking to have the attached image recreated in your own style. Please provide a portfolio showcasing similar work.
wf.summary: Client wants a human-designed event poster, recreating an attached mockup in the designer's own style, no AI-generated art.

practice.q: The client says 'recreate the attached image in your own style.' What is the client really asking for?
options: Copy the mockup pixel for pixel
Rebuild the same layout with your own design choices
Generate a new poster with an AI tool
practice.why: They want the mockup's layout and message kept, but the artwork drawn and styled by you. Copying exactly or using AI both miss the point.
practice.need: I'll rebuild your poster by hand in my own style, keeping your mockup's layout and key info.

wf.skill: Briefing the client: clarifying what 'recreate' means
wf.pitch: Hi, I can design your performance poster by hand, keeping the layout and key details from your mockup while giving it my own clean style. I'll send you a first draft within two days for feedback. Would you like to share the event date, venue, and any brand colours?

wf.title: Modern Celebration of Life Booklet
wf.brief: I need a simple, modern fold-and-staple booklet for a celebration of life event. Content includes: - Photos - Family memories - Personal messages Requirements: - Design should be clean and modern - Quick turnaround is essential, as I need this ASAP Ideal Skills & Experience: - Graphic design proficiency - Experience with booklet layouts - Ability to meet tight deadlines Please provide samples of similar work.
wf.summary: Client wants a clean, modern fold-and-staple celebration of life booklet with photos, family memories and personal messages, fast.

practice.q: What does the client really need most, given the tight deadline?
options: A fancy custom illustration style
A clean, simple layout delivered fast
A full brand identity and logo
practice.why: Speed and clarity matter most here. A clean, simple layout that fits photos and messages neatly beats fancy extras when the deadline is tight.
practice.need: I'll deliver a clean, modern fold-and-staple booklet layout fast, with photos and memories placed neatly.

wf.skill: Reading what the client really needs before designing
wf.pitch: I can design a clean, modern fold-and-staple booklet that places your photos, family memories and personal messages neatly, and I can turn a print-ready file around quickly. Would it help if I sent you a quick layout preview today?

wf.title: Elegant Christian Crusade Flyer
wf.brief: I need a polished, print-ready poster or flyer that clearly shares our crusade’s full schedule and key information while keeping an elegant, formal tone. The finished design should present the date, time, and venue prominently, introduce the guest speaker alongside our church name, and round out the content with our contact number and social-media handles for follow-up inquiries. Clean typographic hierarchy, balanced white space, and a restrained color palette will communicate the reverent yet welcoming spirit we want. The layout must translate well for both digital distribution (JPEG/PNG for social posting) and high-resolution print (A4 or US Letter at 300 DPI). Deliverables: • Press-ready
wf.summary: Client wants an elegant, print-ready Christian crusade flyer with date, time, venue, speaker, church name, and contact/social handles.

practice.q: Which element must be the most prominent on the flyer, and why?
options: The church logo, so it stays on brand
Date, time and venue, so people can act
The speaker's full biography paragraph
practice.why: Event flyers succeed when the when and where are impossible to miss. Put date, time and venue first, then speaker and contact details. Balance and white space make it feel elegant.
practice.need: I'll design a clean, print-ready crusade flyer with date, time and venue made prominent, for both A4 print and social posts.

wf.skill: Making the event details impossible to miss
wf.pitch: Hello, I can create an elegant, print-ready crusade flyer with the date, time and venue clearly highlighted, plus your speaker, church name and contact details. I'll deliver A4 at 300 DPI and a social-ready PNG. Would you like to see a sample layout first?

wf.title: Paket Branding Minimalis Modern
wf.brief: Saya memerlukan paket branding lengkap bergaya minimalis dan modern untuk sebuah bisnis baru. Ruang lingkup pekerjaan ini meliputi: • Logo utama dan variasi warna/monokrom dalam format vektor (AI, EPS) serta PNG transparan • Palet warna resmi beserta tipografi yang konsisten • Panduan singkat penggunaan logo dan elemen visual (brand guideline ringan) • 5–6 template posting media sosial siap pakai (Instagram square & story) • Satu brosur atau flyer satu halaman yang mengikuti gaya visual yang sama Desain harus bersih, mudah diaplikasikan, dan tetap terasa profesional. Pastikan semua file final dapat diedit sepenuhnya, tertata rapi dalam folder terstruktur, dan siap dicetak atau diunggah.
wf.summary: Client wants a full minimalist, modern branding kit: logo variants, palette, type, brief guide, 5-6 social templates, and a flyer.

practice.q: Which deliverable most directly protects the brand's consistency across everything else the client receives?
options: The Instagram story templates
A locked palette and type system
The vector logo file format
practice.why: The brief asks for consistency across all pieces. A locked palette and type system is what every other file inherits from, so define it first and build everything on it.
practice.need: I'll build a clean, editable brand kit with logo, palette, type, and matching social and flyer templates.

wf.skill: Building one consistent visual system across all files
wf.pitch: Hi, I'd be happy to create your minimalist, modern brand kit. I'll deliver vector and PNG logo variants, a locked palette and type system, a short usage guide, six editable Instagram templates, and a matching one-page flyer. Which colours or feelings would you like the brand to communicate?

wf.title: InDesign create a new workbook from the template of the photography 4 Teens workbook already made.
wf.brief: We are looking for someone to create and format a professional, full-color student workbook for our new Entrepreneurship 4 Teens course. We will provide all the written content, photos, graphics, and instructions. Your job will be to organize and design each lesson with a clean, creative, and consistent layout that matches our other Film School 4 Teens workbooks. This includes formatting text, adding images and graphics, creating attractive assignment pages, and making sure every lesson follows the same design style. The final workbook must be ready for professional printing, and we will need the editable design files as well.
wf.summary: Client wants a full-color, print-ready InDesign student workbook for an Entrepreneurship 4 Teens course, matching existing Film School workbooks.

practice.q: What does the client really need from this job?
options: A fresh writing project with new lesson content
Consistent, print-ready layout matching the existing series
Photo editing and video filming for the course
practice.why: The brief is about layout work, not writing or filming. Matching the existing template's style across every lesson, plus print-ready and editable files, is the core of the job.
practice.need: I'll build all lessons in one consistent InDesign template matching your Film School workbooks, print-ready.

wf.skill: Briefing the client on the real deliverable
wf.pitch: I'll format your Entrepreneurship 4 Teens workbook so every lesson matches your Film School template, with clean spacing, placed images, and print-ready PDF plus editable InDesign files. Could you share the template file and the print specs (page size, bleed) so I can start?

wf.title: Food Safety Class Marketing Materials -- 2
wf.brief: I need a flyer designed to get people to sign up for my online food safety class. The flyer should be engaging and informative. The flyer must include: - Class details: Online, 75 minutes, local only - Best price with discount code: This is fun Ideal Skills and Experience: - Graphic design expertise - Experience creating educational or promotional material - Ability to create eye-catching and informative layouts
wf.summary: Client wants an engaging, informative flyer to sign up people for a 75-min online food safety class, with discount code 'This is fun'.

practice.q: What must the flyer make impossible to miss, given the client wants sign-ups?
options: The class topic and course history
The price with the discount code and a clear sign-up step
A long list of food safety rules
practice.why: Flyers get ignored when the offer is buried. Lead with the discount code, the 75-minute online format, and one clear next step. Everything else supports that.
practice.need: I'll design a clear, eye-catching flyer that puts your discount code and class details up front.

wf.skill: Making the offer impossible to miss
wf.pitch: Hi, I can design a bold, easy-to-read flyer for your online food safety class. The discount code 'This is fun' and the 75-minute online details will be front and centre so people know exactly how to sign up. Would you like a WhatsApp-ready version as well as print?

wf.title: BuildSure Corporate Brochure Design
wf.brief: Dear Sir/Madam, We invite creative designers to design an innovative, attractive and professionally crafted four-page A4-size brochure for: BuildSure – Centre for Construction Material Testing & Quality Assurance (Unit of JSS Academy of Technical Education, Bengaluru) NABL Accredited Laboratory The brochure should reflect BuildSure's professional identity, technical excellence and NABL accreditation. The design must be modern, visually appealing and innovative, with colour combinations that complement the official BuildSure logo. Key content to be highlighted: Introduction to BuildSure and its objectives NABL Accreditation and quality commitment Laboratory infrastructure and testing faciliti
wf.summary: Design a 4-page A4 corporate brochure for BuildSure, a NABL-accredited construction materials testing lab, in its brand colours.

practice.q: What is the most important thing this client needs from the brochure?
options: Cheap, quick flyers to hand out
A modern, credible brochure showing NABL accreditation and testing capabilities
Recruiting new lab staff
practice.why: This is a corporate credibility piece: the design must look modern and professional, match the BuildSure logo colours, and clearly show the accreditation, objectives and lab facilities across four pages.
practice.need: I'll design a modern 4-page A4 brochure that matches your logo colours and puts your NABL accreditation front and centre.

wf.skill: Briefing the client to pin down what success looks like
wf.pitch: Hi, I'd like to design your BuildSure brochure. I'll build a clean 4-page A4 layout in your logo colours, with the NABL accreditation and lab facilities given clear space. Would you like to see a sample page first?

cv.title: Professional Document & Resume Editing
cv.brief: I have several documents that need clear, error-free polishing. Most are business letters and résumés intended for formal submission, so tone, structure, and grammar must be spot-on. Your task is to review the existing drafts, tighten the language, fix any inconsistencies, and deliver a clean, ready-to-send version in Word (with tracked changes) and a final PDF. Accuracy, respect for confidentiality, and a quick turnaround are essential. If you have a keen eye for professional formatting and wording that gets results, I’d like to work with you.
cv.summary: Client needs several business letters and résumés polished: tone, structure, grammar fixed, delivered as tracked Word plus clean PDF.

practice.q: What does the client really need from this job?
options: Just a quick spell-check of the files
Rewritten, error-free documents ready to submit
Design work to make the files look modern
practice.why: The brief asks for formal, error-free, ready-to-send documents. Spell-checking alone misses tone and structure, and design wasn't requested. Read for the goal: submission-ready.
practice.need: I'll polish your letters and résumés into clean, submission-ready files with tracked changes.

cv.skill: Matching the document to the formal submission goal
cv.pitch: Hi, I'd be glad to help with your business letters and résumés. I'll tighten the wording, fix grammar and structure, and send you a tracked Word file plus a clean PDF. Would you like me to start with a sample page first?

cv.title: ATS Optimized Finance Graduate Resume
cv.brief: I’m an entry-level graduate aiming for finance, accounting, and banking positions within large multinational corporations. My current résumé needs a full professional overhaul so it can sail through modern Applicant Tracking Systems and showcase my potential to hiring managers in these high-stakes environments. You’ll start from my existing document and transform it into a clean, results-oriented résumé that speaks the language of finance while remaining fully ATS compliant. That means strategic keyword placement, metrics-driven bullet points, clear section hierarchy, and formatting that stays intact whether it’s scanned by software or reviewed by a human. I also want subtle tailoring toward
cv.summary: Client wants an ATS-friendly finance graduate CV for entry-level finance, accounting, and banking roles at multinationals.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need beyond just a nicer-looking CV?
options: A CV that passes ATS filters and reads well to humans
A fancy design with photos and graphics
A long, detailed list of every course taken
practice.why: Good work here means the CV must survive software scans and still impress a person. Fancy graphics often break ATS parsing, so clean formatting and keywords matter more than looks.
practice.need: I'll turn your CV into a clean, ATS-ready finance résumé with metrics-driven bullets.

cv.skill: Making the offer impossible to miss
cv.pitch: Hi, I'm interested in your finance graduate CV project. I'll rebuild your résumé with a clean section structure, strategic finance keywords, and metric-driven bullet points that pass ATS scans and still impress hiring managers. Could you share your current CV and the roles you're targeting?

ig.title: Google & Instagram Profile Makeover
ig.brief: We have recently renovated our restaurant and would like to update our online presence to reflect its new appearance and atmosphere. 1. Google Business Profile Remove all old photos uploaded by the business. Replace them with our new professional photos. Food and beverage photos uploaded by customers can remain. All new photos will be provided by us. 2. Instagram Account Remove all existing photos and posts. Upload the new photos provided by us. Create a fresh, modern and consistent appearance that reflects the newly renovated restaurant. Project Objective The goal is to refresh both platforms and ensure that our online presence accurately represents the restaurant's new design, atmosphere a
ig.summary: Client wants Google Business and Instagram cleared of old photos and refreshed with new restaurant renovation photos.
ig.pitch: Hi, I'd love to refresh your Google and Instagram for the renovation. I'll remove the outdated business photos, keep your customers' food shots, and upload your new photos into a clean, consistent look. Would you like me to start with Google or Instagram first?

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need from this job?
options: Write new captions for every old post
Replace old business photos with theirs, keep customer photos
Create new menus and run paid ads
practice.why: Read the brief closely: remove old business photos, keep customer food photos, and upload the client's new photos to both platforms. Sticking to exactly that scope is the job.
practice.need: I'll replace your old photos on Google and Instagram with your new renovation shots, keeping a consistent look.

ig.title: Social Media Tutorials for a Small Business
ig.brief: My budget is under $50, and I’m just looking for a short-term learning opportunity rather than ongoing management or extensive projects.
ig.summary: Client wants short Instagram tutorials teaching their small business to post on their own, for under $50.
ig.skill: Teaching a small business to post on its own
ig.pitch: Hi, I read that you want short Instagram lessons so your team can post confidently on their own. I can deliver a focused, hands-on tutorial covering post planning, captions, and a simple weekly posting routine within your $50 budget. Would a short session like that work for you?

practice.q: What does this client REALLY need from you?
options: Full account management and daily posting
Short hands-on lessons they can apply themselves
Paid ads setup and campaign strategy
practice.why: The brief says short-term learning, not ongoing management. Teach the owner to post well themselves, and keep the scope tight to fit the budget.
practice.need: I'll walk your team through a short, practical Instagram posting lesson within your $50 budget.

ig.title: Daily FB-IG Posts & TikTok
ig.brief: I’m ready to hand over my day-to-day social media scheduling so our feed stays active without me hovering over it. Here’s the rhythm I need you to keep: • Facebook and Instagram must feature a fresh post every single day, then cycle that same post automatically at 8 am, noon, and 5 pm. You’re free to use Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Later, Hootsuite—whatever calendar tool you trust—as long as it fires on time. • Each post should push our products and services up-front and motivate viewers to drop by the store. Clear calls to “come see us today” must sit alongside our street address, opening hours, simple map directions with parking notes, plus any in-store specials or events we’re running. C
ig.summary: Client wants daily FB/IG posts auto-scheduled at 8am, noon, 5pm, pushing products with store address, hours, directions, and specials.

practice.q: What must every post include beyond the product, so viewers actually visit the store?
options: Only a nice photo and hashtags
A clear 'come see us today' call with address and hours
Long captions about the brand's history
practice.why: Good work here means each post sells the visit. Pretty images alone won't bring people in. Put the call to visit, the address, hours, and directions right alongside the offer, then schedule it.
practice.need: I'll schedule daily FB and IG posts that drive store visits, with address, hours, and specials.

ig.skill: Making the offer impossible to miss
ig.pitch: I can set up your daily Facebook and Instagram posts at 8am, noon, and 5pm, each with a clear 'come see us today' call, your address, hours, and specials. Would you like me to start with this week's offers?

ig.title: Entry-Level Social Media Assistant
ig.brief: I’m ready to hand over day-to-day management of my Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok accounts so I can keep pushing the business forward. You’ll log in to my Content360 scheduler, upload the posts and short-form videos I provide (or that you help me brainstorm), and make sure everything goes out cleanly and on time. Besides clicking “publish,” I’ll lean on you to craft engaging captions, hooky headlines, and fresh post ideas that nudge viewers toward becoming customers while steadily building trust in the brand. When I have a question—anything from market trends to competitor moves—I’ll tap you for quick, well-sourced research so I can make faster decisions. Up front, the pay is modest; I’m a
ig.summary: Client wants a freelancer to run Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok via a scheduler: publish posts, write captions, and suggest ideas.

practice.q: Which part of this job is most about turning viewers into customers rather than just posting on time?
options: Publishing on schedule with no errors
Writing captions and headlines that drive sales
Doing deep market and competitor research
practice.why: Clicking publish is the easy part. Captions and headlines that nudge viewers toward buying are what the client is really paying for. Keep that focus.
practice.need: I'll write captions and headlines that move viewers toward buying, and schedule them cleanly on time.

ig.skill: Making the offer impossible to miss
ig.pitch: Hi, I can take over your Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok scheduling and keep posts going out on time. I'll write captions and hooky headlines that point viewers toward becoming customers, and suggest fresh post ideas. Would you like me to start with a sample week of posts?

ig.title: Professional Brand Creation for Social Media -- 2
ig.brief: I need a brand identity for my online products that will make me look professional and trustworthy on Instagram and Facebook. Key tasks include: - Developing branded templates for posts and stories Ideal skills and experience: - Graphic design expertise - Proficiency in Instagram and Facebook - Strong understanding of brand development Looking forward to your creative solutions!
ig.summary: Client wants a professional brand identity with templates for Instagram and Facebook posts and stories.

practice.q: What does the client really need from this brand identity?
options: Flashy designs that go viral fast
Consistent, trustworthy templates across posts and stories
A full website and online store setup
practice.why: Trust comes from consistency. Reusable templates that look the same across every post and story make a small product business look established. Start with the feel, then build the templates from it.
practice.need: I'll build consistent Instagram and Facebook post and story templates that make your products look trustworthy.

ig.skill: Building consistent templates that signal trust
ig.pitch: Hi, I can help you look professional and trustworthy on Instagram and Facebook. I'll create a simple brand identity with matching post and story templates you can reuse for every product. Would you like to see a sample layout first?

ig.title: Luxury Instagram Content Creation
ig.brief: I have a library of high-resolution photos and raw video clips ready to be transformed into a luxury, premium-feeling Instagram feed that strengthens my professional brand image. Your role is to take these assets, elevate them through thoughtful editing, and supplement the feed with fresh AI-generated graphics that match the same refined aesthetic. What I’ll supply • A steady stream of product shots, lifestyle photos, and short video snippets. • Brand guidelines outlining colour palette, fonts, and tone. What I need from you • Polished photo posts that retouch and enhance my original pictures. • Short, captivating reels cut from my footage—complete with on-brand transitions, music, and capti
ig.summary: Client wants a luxury-feel Instagram feed: retouch their photos, cut reels from footage, and add AI graphics matching brand guidelines.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need beyond making the photos look pretty?
options: Pretty photos with no strategy behind them
A feed that looks premium and consistent with their brand
Random AI graphics to fill the grid quickly
practice.why: Luxury feel comes from consistency: colours, fonts and tone from their guidelines applied across every post. Editing alone isn't the job; the feed has to read as one coherent brand.
practice.need: I'll make your feed look consistently premium, using your palette, fonts and tone on every post.

ig.skill: Pretty isn't the goal: matching the brand's look
ig.pitch: Hi, I read your brief and I can help your feed feel consistently premium. I'll retouch your product and lifestyle shots and cut short reels that follow your colour palette, fonts and tone. Would you like to send over a few sample assets so I can show you a first edit?
